# oblique_entitlement (Resource)

An entitlement represents a permission or access right that can be granted to users or teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Entitlements grant a subject (user, team, or group) access to a resource.
# Both the resource and the subject must already exist.
#
# Use `justification` to document why the access is granted. Use `ttl` or
# `expire_time` to grant time-bound access that expires automatically.

data "oblique_resource" "github_users" {
  name = "resources/github-users"
}

data "oblique_group" "engineering" {
  name = "groups/engineering"
}

# Grant a group permanent access to a resource.
resource "oblique_entitlement" "github_engineering" {
  resource      = data.oblique_resource.github_users.name
  subject       = data.oblique_group.engineering.name
  justification = "Engineering employees have access to GitHub"
}

data "oblique_user" "contractor" {
  email = "contractor@example.com"
}

# Grant a user temporary access with a TTL.
resource "oblique_entitlement" "github_contractor" {
  resource = data.oblique_resource.github_users.name
  subject  = data.oblique_user.contractor.name
  ttl      = "2592000s" # 30 days
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource` (String) The resource that this entitlement grants access to.

Format: `resources/{resource}`
- `subject` (String) The subject that is granted access to the resource. This can be a user, team, or group.

Format: `users/{user}`, `teams/{team}`, `groups/{group}`

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `expire_time` (String) If present, when this access expires. This field is always provided on output.
- `imported` (Boolean) When true, this boolean indicates this entitlement was "imported" from a syncing process, such as reading data from Okta or Google Groups. User created entitlements will always cause this field to be false or unset.
- `justification` (String) Human readable justification for the entitlement to be granted. For example, this may contain a link to a ticket or other artifacts.
- `name` (String)
- `okta_app` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--okta_app))
- `ttl` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Input only. The TTL for this resource.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Create and update timestamps.
- `disabled_time` (String) When set, this entitlement is disabled and does not grant access to the resource. Disabled entitlements are still returned in list responses. Entitlements can only be disabled by policies (at the time of enforcement, which will either be at the point of activating the policy or when a controller run detects a violation) and cannot be manually set by the client.
- `disabling_policies` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this entitlement is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the calling client. Omitted from responses when the entitlement is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `request` (String) If present, the request that most recently created or updated this entitlement.

Format: `requests/{request}`
- `update_time` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--okta_app"></a>
### Nested Schema for `okta_app`

Optional:

- `group` (String) The ID of the group that the entitlement is assigned to. Either this or individual will be set.
- `individual` (Boolean) If true, the entitlement is an "individual" app assignment.
- `resource` (String) The resource that represents this okta group.


<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
